svg.text: Judah in the crisis of 701 BC
Jerusalem and Lachish • locations for the Sennacherib and Hezekiah account
Lachish: captured by Sennacherib. Jerusalem: Hezekiah’s capital, not captured in this campaign.
Geographic context • generalised coastlines and water outlines; no imperial boundary or campaign route implied.
